subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up — HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2 evidence

Subject: Deployment mode follow-up & SOC 2 / HIPAA next steps

Hi Priya & Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs (from your team):
- Protected Health Information (PHI) handling — must be HIPAA-compliant, customer needs a signed BAA.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence for security posture and controls.
- Preference for network isolation; evaluating Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) vs Private VPC/on-prem.
- Audit and log retention requirements: 7 years for certain workflows, immediate access to audit logs for periodic audits.

What we propose:
1) Immediate: I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a draft BAA for your legal/security review (see attachments).
2) Technical alignment call: I'll loop in Rishi (infrastructure lead) and Marissa (solutions) to walk through Dedicated vs Private VPC tradeoffs next week.
3) Paperwork: If Elara confirms BAA terms, we can begin a Dedicated pilot while we scope a Private VPC path if required by procurement.

Requested items from Elara to help us scope accurately:
- Clarify whether PHI processing will be inbound (Elara-hosted) or generated by Redwood outputs.
- Specific audit log retention windows and who will request logs (internal auditor vs third party).
- Any required IP allowlists / firewall rules for Private VPC.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm availability for a technical call on Tue/Wed next week? (I can send an invite for Rishi/Marissa to join.)
- If you can share a preferred timeline for contract execution/BAA review, that would help prioritize.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf, Redwood_BAA_draft.docx

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your timeline.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

4) Procurement timeline: We are targeting a Q1 2027 production go-live. Procurement will need the BAA and SOC 2 evidence in the next 3–4 weeks to start approvals.

Can Rishi and Marissa join the call next week — Tue/Wed works for us.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@elarahealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up & SOC 2 / HIPAA next steps

Priya —

Thanks for the specifics. Quick answers inline and a proposed agenda for the technical call.

1) SOC 2 scope: The attached Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf is a customer-friendly summary; the full SOC 2 Type II report covers the production inference environment and our hosted controls. For customers that require the full report under NDA, we can provision the complete report to your security team.

2) Deployment mode differences (summary):
- Hosted API (shared): Fastest to get started, available controls: TLS, RBAC, logging. Not appropriate for PHI unless covered by a BAA and explicit contractual controls — generally not recommended for PHI at scale.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Dedicated GPU pools logically isolated at the tenant level, SLA-backed throughput and latency guarantees, network isolation through dedicated subnets, and option for bring-your-own-KMS. Good balance for teams that want isolation without on-prem complexity.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Full network isolation, customer-managed VPC peering, optional HSM/KMS integrations, and support for air-gapped on-prem deployments. Best when procurement/regulator requires physical/network separation.

3) Audit logs & retention: We currently offer audit log streaming to customer-managed S3 and an export API. Retention: platform default 90 days; we offer extended retention add-ons (1 year, 7 years) as part of an enterprise package. Logs are immutable once written (write-once S3 with object-lock) when configured via the enterprise retention plan.

4) SLAs & uptime: For Dedicated we offer 99.9% uptime for inference endpoints with a financially-backed SLA available on reserved contracts. Private VPC SLAs depend on customer infra but we support runbooked failover and regional routing.

Proposed technical call agenda (30–45 min):
- Quick intros (5)
- Deployment modes deep dive (Dedicated vs Private VPC) (10)
- Security controls: KMS/HSM, key rotation, network controls, audit log flow (10)
- Next steps for BAA & SOC2 report NDA (5)

Rishi & Marissa — can you confirm availability Tue 11/16 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 11/17 09:00–10:00 PT? If those don't work, suggest two windows and I will coordinate.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf, Redwood_BAA_draft.docx

Thanks,
Dylan

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@elarahealth.com>, Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up & SOC 2 / HIPAA next steps

Hi Priya / Tom —

Looping in a few technical details to help your security team prep for the call. Apologies for the longer note.

Dedicated vs Private VPC — technical specifics:
- Dedicated: Tenant-level isolation with per-tenant vCPU/GPU reservations. Network isolation via dedicated subnets and security groups; we can offer VPC peering or private link into your cloud account. Key management: bring-your-own-KMS supported (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), with envelope encryption and KMS access logging.
- Private VPC: Deployments run within your cloud account (Redwood control plane optional) or on-prem package. This gives you full control over network ACLs, NACLs, and the ability to enforce stricter egress rules. HSM integrations possible but require additional ops work to provision HSM keys.

Audit logging & retention:
- We stream inference event logs (metadata only — no full prompt text unless requested) to customer S3 via Kinesis. For PHI-related events, we can configure conditioned logging to include specific fields you require.
- Retention add-on supports object-lock for immutable storage for up to 7 years. We can provide a signed attestation and sample log export during the audit.

Evidence & timelines:
- SOC 2 Type II full report: available under NDA today. If you sign the NDA this week we can deliver the report within 48 hours.
- BAA: we included a draft in the attachments. Legal can discuss redlines; standard turnaround for our customers is 1–2 weeks.

Risks / considerations:
- If your policy requires that no PHI leave Elara-managed VPCs, Private VPC/on-prem is the only compliant path.
- Dedicated is typically acceptable when a signed BAA is in place and the customer is comfortable with our tenant-level isolation + BYOK.

Suggested next steps for the call:
- Confirm whether Elara requires PHI to never leave customer-controlled network (this is the main determinant).
- If not, we can provision a Dedicated pilot while legal finalizes the BAA. For the pilot we can limit test data to synthetic/anonymized PHI to validate throughput and logging.

I can join the Tue/Wed windows Dylan proposed. Let me know which works and I will share a short diagram and runbook before the call.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
